_comment: Emulator-only Firebase config, used by `npm run test:storage-rules`. The real firebase.json declares storage as an ARRAY entry keyed by bucket (which is what deploys need); the emulator refuses that form — it demands a deploy `target`, which would mean running `firebase target:apply` before every test. This file gives the emulator the single-object form it wants and nothing else. storage.rules is the SAME file both read.
